text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган takes first in the
Kikuka Sho.
However, the audience is
still wildly impressed
with Фудзи Кисэки for
attempting a race she has no
aptitude
for.

After the race, she asks to participate in
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a
1,200-meter G1 turf
sprint.

I'm puzzled by her sudden change of
heart, but
I'm sure she has a reason.
